# CONFORMANCE FIXTURES: enums (spec 6.2). A variant literal leans on the LEFT side's
# vocabulary; `.is()` resolves against the receiver's.

== a variant literal on the right of equality
env mode: enum(idle, run, fault) = run
expr mode == .run
want bool true

== a variant literal misses
env mode: enum(idle, run, fault) = run
expr mode == .idle
want bool false

== inequality against a variant
env mode: enum(idle, run, fault) = run
expr mode != .idle
want bool true

== is tests a variant
env mode: enum(idle, run, fault) = run
expr mode.is(run)
want bool true

== is misses
env mode: enum(idle, run, fault) = run
expr mode.is(fault)
want bool false

== int is the backing value
env mode: enum(idle, run, fault) = run
expr mode.int
want num 1

== name is the variant name
env mode: enum(idle, run, fault) = run
expr mode.name
want text "run"

== str renders the variant name
env mode: enum(idle, run, fault) = fault
expr str(mode)
want text "fault"

== num converts the backing value
env mode: enum(idle, run, fault) = fault
expr num(mode)
want num 2

== name as a builtin
env mode: enum(idle, run, fault) = idle
expr name(mode)
want text "idle"

== an enum meets its backing number
env mode: enum(idle, run, fault) = run
expr mode == 1
want bool true

== an enum meets its variant text
env mode: enum(idle, run, fault) = run
expr mode == "run"
want bool true

== an enum misses foreign text
env mode: enum(idle, run, fault) = run
expr mode == "idle"
want bool false

== enums are wire-legal
tier wire
env mode: enum(idle, run, fault) = run
expr mode == .run
want bool true

== a typo of a variant refuses
env mode: enum(idle, run, fault) = run
expr mode == .bogus
error no variant 'bogus'

== is refuses a typo
env mode: enum(idle, run, fault) = run
expr mode.is(bogus)
error no variant 'bogus'

== a variant needs an enum on the left
expr 5 == .run
error needs an enum on the left

== an enum refuses a bool compare
env mode: enum(idle, run, fault) = run
expr mode == true
error comparison mixes

== ordered comparison refuses enums
env mode: enum(idle, run, fault) = run
expr mode < 2
error ordered comparison wants num

== a conditional keeps an agreeing enum pair typed
env mode: enum(idle, run, fault) = run
env on: bool = true
expr (on ? mode : mode) == .run
want bool true
